}}'''Rahman''' is a powerful noble from [[Arad Doman]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Rahman}}

== Activities ==
Orders from [[Alsalam Saeed Almadar|King Alsalam]] went directly to Rahman and other Domani nobles instead of [[Rodel Ituralde]], sending them in different directions. This led to a number of pitched battles in the night between members of different parts of the same army.{{ref/book|10|p}}
